title: Duskhaul
description: Carve through the horde, stuff your bag with cursed relics, and reach an extraction gate before the dark swallows you.
prompt: A hybrid of a Vampire Survivors-style horde survivor and an extraction shooter: fight through swarming horrors, loot as much as you can carry, and escape through an extraction gate before you die. Grimdark fantasy, dirty pixel-art look, meta progression between runs, and multiple zones — castles, outlands, desert, winter mountains.
versionNote: The build that takes the human feedback loop. Currently identical to the AI original — it diverges the moment the first round of playtest notes lands.
